title: Evidence Receipts and Audit Bundles
negative_results: tampering with a receipt's content breaks verification (verify_bundle returns False)
altering a recorded chain hash, reordering receipts, or tampering with the chain head all break verification
a private token in a receipt is refused at seal time before it can enter the signed chain
a non-ReceiptType kind, an empty receipt_id, and an off-shape (schema-violating) event all fail safely

claims.statement: A hash-chained audit bundle of decode receipts, search-space accounting, holdout seals, and challenge results assembles, verifies, and projects each receipt to a provenance_event.schema.json event; tampering breaks verification (POWER).

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic receipts only; private tokens refused before sealing; bundle asserts no geographic/physical claim
